card.name: Colon or dash opening a bullet list
card.fires_on: The colon or hyphen right after a lead-in phrase such as "can help to", "include" or "such as", where a dash-bulleted list begins. Also fires on the first bullet dash itself.

modes.label: Colon before a list
modes.description: A colon ending a lead-in sentence, with a dash-bulleted list following.

modes.description: The hyphen that starts the first item of a list after a colon.

card.writes: Promotes bullet-like and list-item starting tokens, which suggests it prepares the start of a list entry.
card.plain: It marks the point where a sentence ends with a colon or dash and a bulleted list begins.
